POWERPLAY
A chess remix · local multiplayer

Same board. New powers.

Classic chess moves—with one game-changing twist.

MOVE 1 POWER CAN CHANGE
White to move
Select a piece to see its legal moves.
King in check

The power shift 01

⇄
Capture = inherit.
Take a piece and your piece gains its movement power. The king always stays a king.

Move history 0 moves

Your opening move awaits.

Captured pieces

White
—
Black
—

Two players, one screen. Tap a piece, then a highlighted square.

How to play

It starts as chess. Every capture rewrites the board.

♟Take a piece, take its power. Your capturing piece inherits the captured piece's movement for the rest of the game.
♚Kings are the exception. A king can capture, but never changes power. Kings cannot be captured.
↗Play to checkmate. Standard check, checkmate, pawn promotion, and castling rules apply. Captured powers are shown on the board.
⌖Local two-player: choose a piece, then a highlighted destination. Use Undo to take back a move.

Pawn promotion

Choose the power your pawn will inherit.
